Regency Silver Corp.: Adding a Past-Producing Gold Mine to Its Sonora, Mexico Portfolio

(OTCQB: RSMXF) (FSE: ZJ90) (the "Company" or "Regency Silver") reviewed the addition of the past-producing Jabali Gold Project, in Sonora, Mexico, including historical drilling of 6.91 grams per tonne gold over 63 metres, 94% recoveries, and proximity to the Mulatos and La India mines.

The article examines the Company's transition from explorer to producer through a toll milling approach, against the backdrop of rising capital costs for putting mines into production. Jabali is located 20 kilometres from the Company's Dios Padre Project.

Regency Silver is a Canadian resource company exploring for high-grade gold, copper, and silver in Mexico. The company's flagship Dios Padre Project in Sonora, Mexico has returned significant drill results across an expanding gold-copper-silver discovery zone.

Market One is a Canadian marketing agency for public companies, delivering best-in-class content creation and distribution. Clients benefit from increased visibility and strengthened awareness through Market One's content and relationships with industry-leading media outlets.
